# Read remaining time (time.remaining)

## categories

[
  "time",
  "runtime"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "deterministic": false,
    "explanation": "Real supervisor time service when enabled. Builder self-tests return an explicitly unavailable fake; no clock read or wait occurs at build time.",
    "id": "remaining",
    "input": {},
    "title": "Read time"
  }
]

## description

Read the original run wall-clock budget remaining in integer milliseconds. elapsed_ms counts active run time, including sleeping but excluding operator-paused downtime. remaining_ms excludes deadline grace and is only a snapshot: delivery and later work consume more time. This capability cannot change any limit.

## failure_modes

[
  {

    "recovery": "Read remaining time and use a permitted bounded request. Only experiment configuration grants policy/permissions.",
    "symptom": "A recorded denial/error without scheduling a wake."
  }
]

## limitations

[
  "Does not extend deadlines, step budgets, permissions or any other limit.",
  "Sleep uses active run time, not a wall-clock alarm across stopped runs; no external scheduler is installed.",
  "Wake delivery is checked at bounded runtime barriers; it is not a real-time guarantee."
]

## name

Read remaining time
